raw_text: Kisan Ekta Zindabad! Tomorrow we march to Delhi for our rights. All tractor convoys must assemble at Shambhu border by 5 AM. Supply trucks with food and water will be at designated points along GT Road. Legal MSP guarantee is our fundamental demand. Share convoy routes in all farmer groups.
clean_text: Farmer union calling for march to Delhi demanding legal MSP guarantee. Tractor convoys to assemble at Shambhu border by 5 AM with supply chain logistics along GT Road.
